'''2004 Utah State Championship''' ("Jaron's Legacy") was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 31 July 2004 at the Washington County Library, 50 South Main, St. George, Utah, and organized by [[Matt Jensen]] (TrekkerMJ). It was six games of Swiss, and first place received a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship]]. Eleven players took part: two from northern Utah, six from St. George and three from Arizona. [[Chris Shaner]] won.<ref name="pcf-3588">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230628/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3588&amp UPDATED!!! 'Official' Utah States Championship Announcement], Matt Jensen (TrekkerMJ) (7 July – 2 August 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 8 September 2004.</ref>
